name: urban-trends-pos
description: Urban Trends POS - builds the website and runs the API as ONE service (used by Railway).

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev && VITE_API_URL=/api npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend ci --omit=dev
scripts.start: node backend/src/db/migrate.js && if [ "$RUN_SEED" = "true" ]; then node backend/src/db/seed.js; fi && node backend/src/server.js
